translation_principles: Reconstruct the complete thought across adjacent cues before translating
Use polished but conversational English for corporate factory-tour voiceovers
Preserve the speaker's first-person perspective and practical factory-owner tone
Translate the complete thought first, then distribute it across the original cue indexes
Keep each cue concise and allow grammar to flow naturally across cue boundaries
Prefer concrete factory vocabulary over abstract brochure language
Store canonical complete-thought English with normal sentence punctuation
Strip terminal punctuation only when rendering each PUREFAITH subtitle cue
